$comment: Single source of truth for VaultDock environment variables, used by install.sh (add-only .env merge, obsolete-variable review), .env.example and GET /admin/deploy/env (api-v1 section 11A). Every entry is a flat object of scalar values (no nested objects or arrays) so install.sh can read it without jq. Fields: name; type (string|bool|int|path|url|enum|list); default (written when the variable is missing); required; secret (value is never shown or returned); generate (hex24 = generate a random token instead of using the default); env_file (install.sh keeps it in app/.env; false = set by docker-compose.yml or only read from the installer's environment); managed (install.sh owns the value and may update it, e.g. the installed image); scope (server|compose|installer); since; obsolete; deprecated_since; replacement; description.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_STATE_PATH
variables.description: Host directory mounted at /state: database, generated TLS material and keys. install.sh sets an absolute path; the default matches docker-compose.yml.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_STORAGE_PATH
variables.description: Host directory mounted at /storage/default for stored files. Put it on the large disk.

variables.name: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME
variables.description: Docker compose project name, so compose commands in the install folder and the source checkout control the same stack. Managed by install.sh.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_ENV_FILE
variables.description: The .env file docker compose passes to the container (env_file). Managed by install.sh.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_UID
variables.description: Container user id that owns the data directories.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_GID
variables.description: Container group id that owns the data directories.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_BIND
variables.description: Host address the VaultDock port is published on. Use 127.0.0.1 behind a tunnel or reverse proxy on the same host.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_PORT
variables.description: Host port VaultDock is published on (the container listens on 8080). Also an installer answer for unattended installs.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Externally visible base URL people open in the browser and enter in the desktop app.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.description: Comma-separated CIDRs or addresses whose X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto headers are trusted.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_INTEGRATIONS
variables.description: Comma-separated opt-in integrations under deploy/integrations/ whose compose override install.sh adds: caddy (Caddy reverse proxy), cloudflared-net (join the Docker network of an existing cloudflared container). Empty means only the vaultdock service runs.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_TUNNEL_NETWORK
variables.description: Docker network of an existing cloudflared container that VaultDock joins (cloudflared-net integration); the tunnel then reaches http://vaultdock:8080. Set by install.sh integrations; empty when unused.

variables.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
variables.description: Enabled the bundled Caddy service (COMPOSE_PROFILES=caddy). Caddy is now the opt-in caddy integration; install.sh migrates it automatically. Keep this variable only if your own docker-compose.override.yml uses profiles.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_DOMAIN
variables.description: Domain served by the caddy integration with a Let's Encrypt certificate. Must resolve to this host; ports 80 and 443 must be reachable.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_TLS_SELF_SIGNED
variables.description: Serve HTTPS directly with a persisted self-signed certificate (LAN). The desktop app pins its fingerprint.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_TLS_HOSTS
variables.description: Comma-separated extra host names and IP addresses for the self-signed certificate.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_TLS_CERT
variables.description: Your own certificate (path inside the container, e.g. under /state). Set together with VAULTDOCK_TLS_KEY.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_TLS_KEY
variables.description: Private key for VAULTDOCK_TLS_CERT (path inside the container).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_SETUP_TOKEN
variables.description: One-time token required to create the first administrator. Generated by install.sh when missing.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_COOKIE_SECURE
variables.description: Secure cookie flag: auto (when HTTPS is detected), true or false.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_KEK_FILE
variables.description: Key-encryption key file (path inside the container). install.sh generates 32 random bytes there on a fresh install (host path: VAULTDOCK_STATE_PATH/keys/kek, mode 0600) and never regenerates an existing one. Back it up off the server; it is never copied off-host automatically.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_CHUNK_SIZE_MB
variables.description: Upload chunk size advertised to clients, in MiB (1-64).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_MAX_CONCURRENT_CHUNKS
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous chunk writes (4-1024).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_UPLOAD_TTL_HOURS
variables.description: How long an idle upload can be resumed, in hours.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_SYNC_TOMBSTONE_DAYS
variables.description: Days sync tombstones (deletion records) are kept before they are purged (90-3650; api-v1 section 10.2 requires at least 90).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_AI_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS
variables.description: Allow AI provider endpoints on private, loopback or link-local addresses (for a self-hosted model on the LAN).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log level: debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: Log format: json or text.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_GEOIP_DB
variables.description: Optional MaxMind/DB-IP city database (.mmdb, path inside the container) for device request locations.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_UPDATE_CHECK
variables.description: Check for new releases every 12 hours and show them in Admin console > Updates.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_UPDATE_REPO
variables.description: GitHub owner/name whose releases are checked.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_AUTO_UPDATE
variables.description: Mirrors the installer's scheduled updates (on/off). Managed by install.sh auto-update on|off.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_IMAGE
variables.description: Container image currently installed. Managed by install.sh; as an installer variable it selects a prebuilt image to pull.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_VERSION
variables.description: Version currently installed (build argument for local builds). Managed by install.sh.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_LISTEN
variables.description: Listen address inside the container. Set by docker-compose.yml.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_STATE_DIR
variables.description: State directory inside the container. Set by docker-compose.yml.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_DEFAULT_STORAGE
variables.description: Storage location created on first start (inside the container). Set by docker-compose.yml.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_STORAGE_ROOTS
variables.description: Comma-separated directories admins may register as storage locations. Set by docker-compose.yml.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_DEV
variables.description: Development mode: relaxes cookie security for local http. Never use in production.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_DIR
variables.description: install.sh: installation directory.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_REPO
variables.description: install.sh: GitHub owner/name to download releases, runtime files and the ghcr.io image from (formerly ASPEC-RACING-PTY-LTD/vad-client).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_REF
variables.description: install.sh: branch or tag to install (default: latest release, else main).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_SOURCE
variables.description: install.sh: install from this local source directory instead of downloading.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_HTTPS
variables.description: install.sh: tunnel | caddy | selfsigned | none; skips the HTTPS question.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_STORAGE
variables.description: install.sh: storage path answer for unattended installs (becomes VAULTDOCK_STORAGE_PATH).

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_REBUILD
variables.description: install.sh: 0 reuses an existing local vaultdock:local image instead of rebuilding.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_PULL
variables.description: install.sh: 1 pulls the registry image even when it is already present.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_YES
variables.description: install.sh: 1 accepts defaults for every prompt. Never approves removing variables.

variables.name: VAULTDOCK_ENV_APPROVE_REMOVE
variables.description: install.sh: comma-separated obsolete variables approved for removal from .env (same as --approve-env-removal).
